जेन्ताक जेन्ताक, अस्, m. a dry hot bath or
heated chamber for inducing perspiration in rheuma-
tism, &c.

जेन्य जेन्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. जन), Ved. of
noble origin (γενναῖος); genuine, true.
—जेन्या-
वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having genuine or true wealth,
an epithet of the Aśvins; also of Indra and Agni;
(Sāy.) having acquired wealth.
